title: TransHarness: From Benchmark Overfitting to Transferable Harness Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2611.33757v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Harness evolution offers a path to improving coding agents without updating model weights. However, existing methods can overfit their evolution benchmarks, producing gains that fail to carry over to new tasks. To address this challenge, we introduce Transferable Harness Evolution (TransHarness), which evolves harness intervention policies from same-task success-failure contrasts. These policies couple execution-context triggers with diagnostic guidance, enabling task-dependent checks and corrections beyond the source executions. Cross-task replay and independent semantic selection retain policies that intervene selectively and ground corrections in current-task evidence rather than source-specific solutions. We further curate an independent evolution set for cross-distribution transfer and conduct a cross-benchmark evaluation covering multiple strong models and a range of lightweight and mature harnesses. translated_title: TransHarness：从基准过拟合到可迁移的 Harness 演化
translated_abstract: Harness 演化为在不更新模型权重的情况下改进编码智能体提供了一条路径。然而，现有方法可能会对其演化基准产生过拟合，由此获得的增益无法迁移到新任务上。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了可迁移 Harness 演化方法 TransHarness，它从同一任务的成功-失败对比中演化出 harness 干预策略。这些策略将执行上下文触发器与诊断性指导相结合，能够在源执行之外实现针对具体任务的检查与修正。跨任务重放与独立的语义筛选机制，保留了那些有选择性地进行干预、并将修正建立在当前任务证据而非源任务特定方案之上的策略。我们进一步构建了一个独立的演化集合用于跨分布迁移，并开展了涵盖多个强模型以及一系列轻量级与成熟 harness 的跨基准评估。实验表明，仅需……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: TransHarness 通过从同任务成功-失败对比中演化可迁移的 harness 干预策略（执行上下文触发结合诊断指导），并借助跨任务重放与独立语义筛选来避免基准过拟合，从而实现能够跨任务、跨基准、跨模型泛化的编码智能体改进。
en_tdlr: TransHarness evolves transferable harness intervention policies from same-task success-failure contrasts, using cross-task replay and independent semantic selection to avoid benchmark overfitting and achieve coding-agent gains that generalize across tasks, benchmarks, and models.
